name: Different shell view - Apps
author: miguel
description: Home becomes a grid of app icons, one per desk (tap opens that desk), Chats first with its Ready count, and a + for an app not open yet. Phone: a home screen, the bottom desk switcher gone (only the orb stays; swipe it up for Home). Desktop: a launchpad over the wallpaper, the orb at the bottom. One view per device type (desktop, phone); all off = Desks
